criteria.text: Documentation describes persistent low back symptoms
criteria.evidence_expectation: A dated chart source describing symptoms and duration

criteria.text: Conservative treatment history is documented for at least six weeks
criteria.evidence_expectation: Source evidence identifying treatment and dates sufficient to calculate duration

criteria.text: A clinician request for lumbar MRI is documented
criteria.evidence_expectation: A dated order or note documenting the request
